summary: Completed AlembicPlugin rework1 in commit 3cb93137e040c3491605945f466fe01febcc3aaf. Terminal Recipe deletion now detects the last active document and reuses Core removeRecipeVectorsByTruth to clear every divergent content-hash document across all known generations plus canonical/legacy base residue, while stale live-update removal remains exact when an active replacement exists. Active-route compare-and-swap now wraps read/compare/write in an atomic dataRoot directory lock shared by independent runtimes/processes and writes PID+UUID collision-safe temporary files. Controller-reported rollback resurrection and 20/20 multi-runtime ENOENT races are covered by regressions. Host submit/Core production, Search, and Prime code were not changed.
